summary: MNTN, Inc. operates a technology platform that brings performance marketing to Connected TV. Its self-serve technology makes running TV ads as easy as search and social and helps brands to drive measurable conversions, revenue, site visits, and more. The company was formerly known as MNTN Digital, Inc. and changed its name to MNTN, Inc. in 2022. MNTN, Inc. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
